name: Notch Island
adaptations: Reuse upstream SwiftUI island design and logos without a renderer implementation.
Add Wisa-only mode with profile-specific UserDefaults suite, private HOME/socket and an exact CGDirectDisplayID; never follow the pointer or choose another display.
Bind Wisa-mode helper lifetime to its parent process with a kernel exit notification, including startup races, crashes and force-quit; leave standalone mode unchanged.
Disable external-agent discovery, transcript reading, process discovery and quota access in Wisa mode; truthfully label Wisa sessions.
Emit newline JSON ready/open events on stdout; explicit jump/Open Wisa actions target the owning Wisa tab instead of an external terminal.
Echo captured _request_id in socket replies, bind UI actions to that request and clear pending UI on socket cancellation; preserve upstream single-use socket answers.
Make global approval shortcuts opt-in and disable synthetic SIGUSR2 approval in Wisa mode; retain SIGUSR1 snapshot/toggle seam.
Honor WISA_NOTCH_SHOW_IDLE by ordering the existing nonactivating all-Spaces/fullscreen-auxiliary panel out when empty.

Use org.wisa.studio.notch bundle identifier; build a universal arm64+x86_64 macOS 14+ helper with source/compiler cache and embedded MIT license. No installer, login item or external hooks are included.

protocol.transport: One newline-terminated JSON event per Unix stream socket; PermissionRequest retains its socket until a single answer or cancellation.
protocol.identity: session_id is Wisa tabId; _agent is wisa; PermissionRequest carries _request_id which is echoed in the reply.
protocol.snapshot: WisaSnapshot carries running, nullable tool_name and last_assistant_message without synthesizing a user prompt; a pending permission request retains its waiting status and controls.
protocol.answers: Object keyed by question text with selected option label as string. Upstream multi-select joins labels with comma-space; Wisa bridge may route ambiguous forms to Open Wisa.
protocol.permissionScope: always is only offered when permission_suggestions is nonempty; only the main-process bridge may apply an exact captured suggestion.
